basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and sports enthusiast from Munich. I recently got into Reddit to connect with others who share my interests, especially in gaming and sports. I work as a physiotherapist, which keeps me busy during the day, but I love unwinding with some gaming in the evenings. On weekends, I'm usually out exploring the city or watching sports with friends. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people, both online and offline. I typically browse Reddit late at night, usually between 10 PM and 1 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a professional background in physiotherapy, which I've been practicing for a few years. My knowledge in gaming mainly comes from personal experience and following various gaming communities online. I also have a keen interest in sports, which I've nurtured through watching games and participating in local sports events.
